public_entry.contract: For 0 <= elements <= 1048576, sum contiguous host fp32 input into one host fp32 output; zero elements returns +0.0; invalid pointers and unsupported sizes return declared status codes.

supported_domain: contiguous fp32 host input, 0 <= elements <= 1048576, finite values generated by the frozen workload
fallback: Return ALLOYPORT_REDUCE_UNSUPPORTED before device allocation or launch; do not silently invoke a framework operator.
